= TestVM web  [in sync]  via test
! NodeUser web/user/app  [blocked]
    warning MAM-GRAPH-0206 user app is added to group docker on web: its members control the Docker daemon, which runs containers as root with the host's files, so the user can become root there
      hint: declare the group only if the user is meant to administer the node; Mamela never removes a membership, so taking it out of the declaration later does not take it away
    MAM-PLAN-0212 mamelet does not write the SSH keys of user app on web: /home/bob is bob's (uid 1000), not app's, and Mamela never writes into another user's home or ~/.ssh
      hint: give app a home of its own by hand (usermod --home), or make the directory app's (chown) if it is meant to be; or leave authorizedKeys out
